info.title: Vendor Registry Service
info.description:
eGov DIGIT platform service that manages the Organisation (vendor) registry: creation, update and search of organisations (with and without workflow), and management of the users (staff) linked to an organisation.

### Authentication
This service does **not** use a header-based Authorization scheme. Every request body carries a `RequestInfo` object, and the JWT bearer token obtained from egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` (password grant) or `/user/_login` (OTP) endpoint must be supplied as `RequestInfo.authToken`. The caller's identity/roles are additionally carried in `RequestInfo.userInfo`. Downstream services validate `authToken` against egov-user; there is no separate `Authorization` header.

post.description: Deletes an organisation user (OrganisationApiController.deleteUserOrg -> OrganisationUserService.deleteUserOrg). OrganisationUserServiceValidator.validateDeleteUserOrgRequest blocks the delete with a org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException(HTTP 409, OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse-shaped JSON reason) when the target user still has active/pending field-planner activity assignments. Because this service registers no custom handler for ResponseStatusException, egov-tracer's generic ExceptionAdvise(Exception.class) intercepts it first and ALWAYS answers with HTTP 400 in the standard ErrorRes envelope - the OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse JSON ends up serialized inside `Errors[0].description` (see example) rather than as a raw 409 body. See the OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse schema for the shape of that embedded payload.

400.description: Bad Request - validation failure, OR a blocked delete due to active/pending activity assignments. In the latter case the OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse payload (see that schema) is embedded, serialized as a string, inside Errors[0].description - it is not returned as a distinct 409 response by this service.

UserInfo.description: org.egov.common.contract.request.User - authenticated caller's identity, embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT RequestInfo envelope carried in every request body. `authToken` is the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's OAuth/_login endpoints and IS the authentication mechanism for this API (there is no separate Authorization header).

authToken.description: Bearer JWT issued by egov-user OAuth token/_login endpoint. This is the sole authentication carrier for this API.

ResponseInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT ResponseInfo envelope returned in every response body.

Error.description: org.egov.tracer.model.Error - single error entry inside ErrorRes.Errors, produced by egov-tracer's global exception handler.

ErrorRes.description: Standard eGov error envelope. Returned with HTTP 400 by egov-tracer's default ExceptionAdvise @ControllerAdvice(Exception.class) whenever a CustomException (or any other uncaught exception, including ResponseStatusException) propagates out of a controller method - this handler always answers with HTTP 400, regardless of the original exception's intended status code.

ActivityAssignment.description: org.egov.web.models.ActivityAssignment - a field-planner activity assignment that blocks deletion of an organisation user.

OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse.description: org.egov.web.models.OrgUserDeleteErrorResponse - raised (as a org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException with HTTP 409 CONFLICT reason) by OrganisationUserServiceValidator.validateDeleteUserOrgRequest when the org user being deleted still has blocking/active field-planner activity assignments. NOTE: because this service has no custom @ExceptionHandler for ResponseStatusException, egov-tracer's generic Exception handler intercepts it first and always answers with HTTP 400 wrapped in the standard ErrorRes envelope (see ErrorRes) - this exact JSON shape is embedded, serialized, inside that response's `Errors[0].description` field rather than being returned as the raw top-level body.
